problem: Find the value of $c$ that satisfies the mean value theorem for $f(x)={log}_{3}⁡x$ on the interval $[9,81].$

feedback.worked_solution:
The function $f(x)$ is continuous on $[-1,3]$ and differentiable on $(-1,3),$ hence we can apply the mean value theorem.  

So, the mean value theorem states that there exists a $c\in (-1,3)$ such that

$$
{f}^{′}(c)=\frac{f(b)-f(a)}{b-a}.
$$

Plugging in $a=-1$ and $b=3$ into the above gives 

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(c) & =\frac{f(3)-f(-1)}{3-(-1)} \\  & =\frac{({3}^{2}+1)-((-1)^{2}+1)}{4} \\  & =\frac{10-2}{4} \\  & =2.\end{aligned}
$$

Differentiating the function, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{2}+1)=2x.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
{f}^{′}(c)=2c.
$$

Finally, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}2c & =2 \\ c & =1.\end{aligned}
$$
